operations.name: latin_status
operations.description: Verify the finite labelled table has exactly one declared symbol in every row and column.

operations.name: row_vectors
operations.description: Preserve every labelled row vector in declared order.

operations.name: column_vectors
operations.description: Preserve every labelled column vector in declared order.

operations.name: symbol_counts
operations.description: Count each declared symbol without treating frequency as empirical data.

operations.name: identity_elements
operations.description: Find two-sided identity candidates inside the supplied table only.

operations.name: idempotent_cells
operations.description: Record diagonal labels whose table value equals their label.

operations.name: commutativity_defects
operations.description: List exact unordered label pairs that fail table symmetry.

operations.name: associativity_defects
operations.description: List exact labelled triples that fail the supplied associativity equation.

operations.name: row_cycle_types
operations.description: Compute finite cycle-length profiles of row permutations.

operations.name: column_cycle_types
operations.description: Compute finite cycle-length profiles of column permutations.

operations.name: left_division_table
operations.description: Solve each bounded row equation for its unique labelled column.

operations.name: right_division_table
operations.description: Solve each bounded column equation for its unique labelled row.

operations.name: intercalates
operations.description: Enumerate exact two-by-two Latin intercalates.

operations.name: row_hamming_matrix
operations.description: Compute exact pairwise row Hamming distances.

operations.name: column_hamming_matrix
operations.description: Compute exact pairwise column Hamming distances.

operations.name: symbol_position_vectors
operations.description: Record each symbol position by declared row and column index.

operations.name: structural_signature
operations.description: Combine bounded invariants without claiming a complete classification.

operations.name: latin_scene
operations.description: Represent table cells as declared-index coordinates without physical meaning.

operations.name: external_reproduction_vacancy
operations.description: Keep independent implementation and external mathematical review visibly absent.

operations.name: decision_authority_gate
operations.description: Keep identity, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, and production decisions closed.

skills.description: Verify the finite labelled table has exactly one declared symbol in every row and column.
Preserve every labelled row vector in declared order.
Preserve every labelled column vector in declared order.
Count each declared symbol without treating frequency as empirical data.
Find two-sided identity candidates inside the supplied table only.
Record diagonal labels whose table value equals their label.
List exact unordered label pairs that fail table symmetry.
List exact labelled triples that fail the supplied associativity equation.
Compute finite cycle-length profiles of row permutations.
Compute finite cycle-length profiles of column permutations.
Solve each bounded row equation for its unique labelled column.
Solve each bounded column equation for its unique labelled row.
Enumerate exact two-by-two Latin intercalates.
Compute exact pairwise row Hamming distances.
Compute exact pairwise column Hamming distances.
Record each symbol position by declared row and column index.
Combine bounded invariants without claiming a complete classification.
Represent table cells as declared-index coordinates without physical meaning.
Keep independent implementation and external mathematical review visibly absent.
Keep identity, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, and production decisions closed.

practices.title: Exact table semantics
practices.practice: Distinguish row, column, symbol, and operation labels.

practices.title: Separate same-owner oracle
practices.practice: Freeze expected results without importing the runtime.

practices.title: Correction ledger
practices.practice: Retain every malformed subject beside its refusal.

practices.title: Accessible readback
practices.practice: Pair compact structures with plain-language boundaries.

practices.title: Edition collation
practices.practice: Compare direct and transformed fixtures without treating them as real editions.

practices.title: Caller-envelope review
practices.practice: Inspect stdout, stderr, status, signal, and timeout.

practices.title: Workload and handover
practices.practice: Keep planning, sessions, seal, canonical, and route separate.

practices.title: Authority vacancy
practices.practice: Keep real rules adjudication, rights, safety, culture, and Maori authority external.

next_practices: Choose a genuinely distinct bounded domain instead of relabelling Latin tables.
Keep a separate oracle and runtime while stating their shared ownership.
Derive visual or symbolic summaries only from persisted outputs after a successful session.
Keep canonical and delivery latches external, one-shot, and separate from recipient completion.
